skill.name: personwise-compliance-training
skill.description: Build interactive compliance training from supplied policies and source materials. The skill grounds course content, reviews checkpoints, and controls access through PersonWise.
skill.summary: Turn supplied compliance materials into grounded, interactive digital-human training.
skill.author: personwiseai

content.value_statement: Compliance teams need accurate courses grounded in current policies. This skill converts supplied materials into interactive training with review checkpoints and controlled publication.
actual_capabilities: Creates interactive digital-human courses from topics, text, or supplied documents.
Keeps obligations, thresholds, and deadlines grounded in supplied source materials.
Uploads user-selected sources and tracks processing until every source is ready.
Reviews outlines, scripts, images, and course state at durable checkpoints.
Publishes private or link-access courses when the requested access mode is authorized.
limitations: Requires PersonWise CLI 1.1.6 or newer and browser-based OAuth.
Requires a PersonWise account with enough course credits and slide capacity.
Does not provide legal advice, certification, licensure, or proof of compliance.
Cannot support claims, requirements, or citations absent from the supplied materials.

use_cases.title: Convert Workplace Policies
use_cases.description: Turn approved workplace policies into an interactive course with practical scenarios and escalation guidance.

use_cases.title: Train Regulated Teams
use_cases.description: Create materials-only training that preserves documented obligations, deadlines, and decision paths.

use_cases.title: Review Existing Courses
use_cases.description: Refine an existing course while preserving its structure and correcting unsupported or inconsistent content.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a compliance training course from the attached policy. Use private access and keep every requirement grounded in the source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner course creation from one policy

prompt_templates.title: Create Materials-Only Training
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a materials-only course for [audience] from these documents. Include practical scenarios, escalation paths, and a short understanding check.
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled training from several approved sources

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Course
prompt_templates.prompt: Review course [project name]. Preserve slide order, correct unsupported claims, improve clarity, and report the final access mode.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Course Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [number] role-specific courses from the supplied materials. Recheck capacity before each course and publish only the authorized access target.

output_examples.input: Create private anti-bribery training for sales staff from our policy.
output_examples.output: Created a private course grounded in the supplied policy. The course covers prohibited conduct, approval paths, realistic scenarios, and escalation contacts.

output_examples.input: Update our existing data-handling course and share it with contractors.
output: Reviewed the existing outline and script against the supplied materials.
Corrected unsupported statements while preserving the course structure.
Enabled link access after confirming the requested publication target.

best_practices: Supply current, approved policies and identify the intended learner group.
State the desired page count and access mode before course creation.
Review legal requirements and escalation contacts before publishing the course.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent policies, legal requirements, or official citations.
Do not treat course completion as certification or proof of legal compliance.
Do not upload files or broaden course access without proper authorization.

faq.question: What source materials can I provide?
faq.answer: You can provide policies, regulatory summaries, training documents, approved text, and selected reference images.

faq.question: Does this skill provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It creates training from supplied materials and routes individual questions to the named compliance owner.

faq.question: Can learners ask questions during the course?
faq.answer: Yes. The digital-human course supports voice questions grounded in the course content.

faq.question: Can the skill publish a public course?
faq.answer: It can enable link access when requested. Private access is the default when no access target is provided.

faq.question: What happens when the account lacks course credits?
faq.answer: The skill reports the service action for obtaining credits. It never purchases credits automatically.

faq.question: Can I revise an existing course?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can review and refine supported fields while preserving the existing slide count and order.
